title: [Fabric] TDM capture crossbar mixes adjacent TDM frames across channel pairs (67.5% torn AAF frames)

milestone.title: Board to Board testing 1x1 TDM Milan V1.2
milestone.description:
For now the goal would be to make the board completely working with 1x1 8 channels multiple cluster:
* Loopback
* pilote tone
* tdm8

Owner schedule update, 2026-09-15: physical I2S/TDM pin verification and same-sample wire-to-pin audio evidence are deferred to milestone 9, I2S and TDM physical validation, due December 31, 2026 (#386 and #448; deferred serial-audio portion of #117). Digital implementation/simulation and the remaining gPTP bench work keep their existing scope. Deferred physical requirements remain open and are not counted as passed in October.

body:
[A10] Found in the #451 TDM8 first-light run (PR #616, [A403]). The reviewer [R392-1](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/pull/616#issuecomment-5872415917) re-derived it independently (F2).

## Defect

On the shipping AX7101 1x1 TDM8 image, the DUT's capture path (TDM DIN, then the capture crossbar, then the AAF talker) builds AAF frames whose samples come from two different TDM frames.

- **Scale:** in a 70 s routed DIN capture, 2,267,868 of 3,360,035 frames (67.5%) are torn. Pairs 1 to 3 are one sample period older than pair 0, in four states that cycle once per 1.958 s beat.
- **Scope:** the render direction (DOUT) showed no torn frame in 3.36 M frames. The source transmits whole frames.
- **Mechanism, as recorded:** in `hdl/ieee1722/aaf/KL_chan_map_capture.sv`, each TDM pair's hold is written by its own pair-valid pulse (lines 486-487). The media-tick walk reads the latest hold of each pair (lines 958-960), with no frame-wide buffer. The TDM frame runs about 10.6 ppm off the media grid, so the tick drifts through the TDM frame and reads each pair either before or after that pair's update.
- **Evidence:** the first-light findings page in PR #616, section "DIN frame coherence", and its archived captures.

## Why it matters

The channels of one talker sample are not time-coherent. Up to one sample period of inter-channel skew moves around at the beat rate. That breaks multichannel phase coherence, which IEEE 1722 AAF assumes: all channels of one sample column are one instant.

## Acceptance

1. Every AAF frame the talker emits carries one TDM frame's samples. Latch whole frames, or apply an equivalent frame-atomic handoff, at the crossbar input.
2. A committed simulation reproduces the torn-frame state against a TDM frame drifting relative to the media grid. It fails at the current head and passes with the fix, in INTERNAL and CRF.
3. The render path's atomicity (DOUT) is unchanged. Resource cost is reported.
4. A bench re-run of the #451 DIN capture shows 0 torn frames.
